description:
This is for Sources Sought Only for interested Vendors regarding the removal of an underground storage tank (TK 101) at Launch Facility Location Echo-10. This location is in Laramie County in Wyoming. Offeror shall be registered in SAM and has a basic NIST SP 800-171 Assessment or CMMC Level 2 at a minimum in order to receive Controlled Unclassified Nuclear Information. 

See attached Statement of Work dated 17 Feb 2026.
